goal: Design and implement a shared durable job worker/control-plane boundary, starting with Managed Artwork ingest as the first supervised vertical slice
first_slice: Inventory runtime/job execution surfaces and choose the minimal shared worker contract for Managed Artwork ingest
non_goals: automatic retry policy for every job kind in the first slice
migrating all job kinds at once
exposing raw job input, summary, errors, source locators, storage handles, local paths, or secrets
validation_gates: cargo check -p taru-core -p taru-db -p taru-api -p taru-server --tests
